title: Determinism test suite + two-client e2e comparison
description: Extend determinism coverage: property-style tests across many seeds/systems/chunks, plus an e2e test where two independent clients request the galaxy and get identical data (SC-2).
acceptanceCriteria: Property test: for 10 random seeds, 10 random stars each, generateSystem is stable across two independent generator invocations (deep equal)
Property test: 200 random (planet, chunk) pairs produce identical nodeId sets and node positions across two invocations

E2E (Playwright, headless chromium): two browser pages (independent contexts) load the app, request the star chart and one system's planet list, and the test deep-compares the two datasets for equality
E2E also verifies the client-side chart matches the server-provided seed (server exposes GALAXY_SEED via /api/health; client derives and compares)
All tests green in `npm run test` and the e2e suite; no flakiness across 3 consecutive runs

steps.details: In src/shared/galaxy/properties.test.ts: seeded loop (use a fixed meta-seed for the test's own randomness so failures are reproducible) comparing double-generated outputs; report first divergence with field path.

In tests/determinism.spec.ts: launch two contexts; both navigate to app; helper pulls star chart (via a dev-only window.__DRIFT__ debug hook or the WS protocol chart message) and planet list for a fixed system; expect deep equality; also assert client seed === server seed.
Run the e2e 3 times; ensure no flakiness (timing-independent comparisons only — no wall-clock values in compared data).

technicalNotes: The e2e needs TASK-70's two-client harness helpers; keep the debug hook (window.__DRIFT__) behind an import.meta.env.DEV flag so it never ships in production builds.
